notes: Closely copies Coach's signature cherry bag charm (dog-leash swivel clip, split ring, rectangular hang tag, glitter resin cherries with a metal leaf) and its coiled snake charm; the hang tag is stamped "china" instead of a brand name (legible in images 1 and 3), so no logo, but the owner may want to weigh the look-alike risk.
